description: This file is a TypeScript configuration file for ESLint, a tool used to identify and fix problems in JavaScript/TypeScript code, specifically tailored for a Vue.js project. It imports various ESLint plugins and configurations to set up linting rules for Vue components, TypeScript files, and testing files, and defines a configuration using 'defineConfigWithVueTs' for specific file patterns.

methods.name: defineConfigWithVueTs
methods.description: Function that defines ESLint configuration with Vue and TypeScript support, accepting various configuration objects and plugin configs.
